title: the biggest / the most
explain_tr: Üç ya da daha fazla şey arasında **en** … olanı söylemek için **superlative** kullanılır: *Everest is **the highest** mountain in the world.*
**Kısa sıfatlar:** **the + -est** → *the cheapest, the oldest, the biggest* (ikileme), *the easiest* (y → iest). **Uzun sıfatlar:** **the most** + sıfat → *the most expensive, the most beautiful*.
Düzensizler: **good → the best**, **bad → the worst**, **far → the furthest**.

**the** düşmez: *She is best student* ✗ → *She is **the** best student.* Grup/yer için **in**: *the tallest **in** the class, the biggest city **in** Turkey*; zaman için genelde **of**: *the best day **of** my life*.
**ever** + Present Perfect ile sık kullanılır: *It's **the best** film I've **ever** seen.* (Şimdiye kadar izlediğim en iyi film.)
explain_en: Superlatives: the + adjective-est (the biggest) or the most + long adjective (the most expensive). Irregular: the best, the worst. Use 'in' with places/groups.

pairs.wrong: This is the most cheapest phone.
He is the taller boy in the class.
pairs.right: He is the tallest boy in the class.

pairs.wrong: It was the most good day of my life.
pairs.right: It was the best day of my life.

pairs.wrong: Istanbul is biggest city of Turkey.
pairs.right: Istanbul is the biggest city in Turkey.

options: My grandfather is the oldest in our family.
My grandfather is older in our family.
My grandfather is the most old in our family.
My grandfather is oldest of our family.
answer: My grandfather is the oldest in our family.

options: She is the most happy person I know.
She is the happiest person I know.
She is the happyest person I know.
She is happiest person I know.
answer: She is the happiest person I know.

exercises.prompt: Which word fits? "It is the ___ expensive car in the shop."
This is the most easy exercise in the book.

exercises.prompt: Who is best football player in the world?

exercises.prompt: Antalya is the more popular city for tourists in Turkey.

exercises.prompt:
Superlative ile cümle yaz:
Ali is 1.70, Kemal is 1.85, Murat is 1.78. (tall)
answer: Kemal is the tallest of the three.

exercises.prompt:
Superlative ile cümle yaz:
This is a very good day. I have never had a better day. (good / of my life)
answer: This is the best day of my life.
It is the best day of my life.
It's the best day of my life.
